title: The Letter of Valparaíso
author: Yara Okafor
blurb: Rafael Sterling, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
